title: Spider finding
description: One confirmed finding, one JSON object per line in findings.jsonl. Written only by the synthesizer. The evidence gate (below) is applied by the verifier/synthesizer, not by JSON Schema alone.

target.description: host or url the finding is on

type.description: RCE | IDOR | SSRF | SQLi | ATO | info-disclosure | ...

detail.description: what it is and how it was found

evidence.description: path under raw/ that backs this finding

execution_evidence.description: proof output (whoami/db version) or OOB callback id that PROVES impact

repro.description: crit-roadmap #1 (OPTIONAL): copy-paste reproduction steps, carried from the attack CANDIDATE. REQUIRED by the payout-gate's report-ready sub-gate (tools/payout-gate.py) — without it bounty-mode payout_ready is pinned false

poc_path.description: crit-roadmap #1 (OPTIONAL): path to a runnable PoC under raw/, carried from the attack CANDIDATE. REQUIRED by the payout-gate's report-ready sub-gate alongside repro

oracle_type.description: crit-roadmap #1 (OPTIONAL): the class oracle that validated this finding (OOB-callback | DB-banner | command-output | cross-account-record | cross-origin-read | flag-capture | ...), carried from the attack return's confirmed[]

oracle_evidence.description: crit-roadmap #1 (OPTIONAL): the re-derivable oracle evidence string, carried from the attack return's confirmed[]

remediation.description: crit-roadmap #1 (OPTIONAL): the fix; the report-ready sub-gate accepts cwe OR remediation

vrt.description: fix3 B4 (OPTIONAL, bounty-mode): the dotted VRT class id (e.g. broken_access_control.insecure_direct_object_references)

priority.description: fix3 B4 (OPTIONAL): the VRT CLASS baseline priority — distinct from `severity` (CVSS band) and from `tier` (B5 reward tier)

eligibility.description: fix3 B4 (OPTIONAL): payout-policy eligibility vs program.eligible/excluded_classes. NEVER changes `severity`

cvss_vector.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): CVSS 3.1 vector built from PROVEN impact

cvss_score.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): Roundup-derived from cvss_vector (deterministic; tools/ev-score.py). `severity` stays the canonical band

tier.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): the evidence-derived REWARD tier (CVSS band cross-checked with VRT priority, resolved through program.reward_table)

tier_reward.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): [min,max] from program.reward_table; omitted in ordinal mode

expected_value.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): reward_value(tier) x novelty_confidence x eligibility_confidence — a RANKING scalar, never a payout claim

ev_basis.description: fix3 B5 (OPTIONAL): the EV audit trail { reward_value, novelty_confidence, eligibility_confidence, mode:monetary|ordinal }

novelty.description: fix3 B3 (OPTIONAL): dedup verdict. could-not-verify is NEVER auto-promoted to novel; novelty NEVER changes severity

novelty_ref.description: fix3 B3 (OPTIONAL): the matching disclosed ref (h1#.../CVE-.../GHSA-.../submitted:f-XXXX) if any

novelty_reason.description: fix3 B3 (OPTIONAL): the reason for the verdict

dedup_coverage.description: fix3 B3 (OPTIONAL): priorart coverage behind the verdict

dedup_checked_ts.description: fix3 B3 (OPTIONAL): when dedup was checked

payout_ready.description: fix3 B2 (OPTIONAL): the SINGLE payable verdict = deterministic AND of the six sub-gates. Computed by the synthesizer, enforced at /triage. Never set by narration

payout_blockers.description: fix3 B2 (OPTIONAL): the unmet sub-gates, each a structured string

payout_distance.description: fix3 B2 (OPTIONAL): the 8-rung payout ladder; payout_ready ⟺ reached report-ready

x-evidence-gate.rule: If type is an impact class and severity is high or critical but execution_evidence is empty, the finding is a CANDIDATE: downgrade severity to medium and prefix title with '[UNCONFIRMED CANDIDATE]'.
x-evidence-gate.refuted: A finding with refuted=true never appears in a report.

x-payout-gate.note: fix3 B2, bounty-mode-only, ALL additions above are OPTIONAL (none in `required`) so every existing impact-run finding validates unchanged. A finding is `payout_ready` only when the six sub-gates all hold — impact-proven (the existing oracle) AND in-scope/ROE (existing scope) AND eligible class (B4) AND paying tier >= objective.min_payable_tier (B5) AND dedup-cleared (B3, not duplicate / not could-not-verify) AND report-ready (ISO-29147 elements). `payout_blockers` lists the unmet ones. Computed by the synthesizer (tools/payout-gate.py), enforced by /triage. could-not-verify dedup is a blocker unless objective.novelty.waive_unverified.
x-payout-gate.red_line: No fabrication, no inflation: a missing CVSS vector is a blocker, not an assumed tier; could-not-verify is never silently promoted to cleared/novel; Spider records, the operator submits.

x-tier-note.note: fix3 B5: `cvss_score` is Roundup-derived from `cvss_vector` per CVSS 3.1; `tier` is the reward-table lookup of that score cross-checked with VRT `priority`; `expected_value` = reward_value(tier) x novelty_confidence x eligibility_confidence; computed by the synthesizer via tools/ev-score.py, bounty-mode-only.
x-tier-note.red_line: Severity/tier are evidence-bound — the vector comes from PROVEN impact and is never inflated to clear a pay floor or reach a higher tier.
